info.name: Analyst Reports Raw Text Analyst Insights calls API

params.name: page
params.description: The page number for pagination (starts at 1)

params.name: page_size
params.description: The number of items to return per page

params.name: status
params.description: Filter by call status. Defaults to COMPLETED. Use ALL to return all statuses.

params.name: symbol
params.description: Filter by stock ticker symbol (e.g. AAPL)

params.name: from
params.description: Filter calls starting on or after this date (RFC3339, e.g. 2024-01-01T00:00:00)

params.name: to
params.description: Filter calls starting on or before this date (RFC3339, e.g. 2024-12-31T23:59:59)

params.name: sort_by
params.description: Field to sort results by (e.g. start_time)

params.name: share_class_figi
params.description: Filter by Share Class FiGi identifier (e.g. BBG000B9XRY4)

params.name: securities
params.description: If true, includes securities information in the response

params.name: info_only
params.description: If true, returns only call metadata without transcript content

params.name: filter
params.description: General filter; pass 'all' to bypass default status filter

items.docs: Retrieve a list of calls with optional filtering and pagination. By default, only COMPLETED calls are returned. Use status=ALL to return all statuses.

params.name: call_id
params.description: The unique identifier of the transcript call

params.name: audio
params.description: Set to false to exclude audio recordings. Defaults to true; returns pre-signed/CDN URLs when included

params.name: pdf
params.description: If true, includes pre-signed URLs for the PDF transcript

params.name: assets
params.description: If true, includes pre-signed URLs for external assets (e.g. slide deck PDFs)

params.name: clean
params.description: If true, returns a cleaner simplified output format

items.docs: Retrieve detailed information about a specific call by its ID

params.name: call_id
params.description: The unique identifier of the transcript call

items.docs: Update details of a specific call by its ID

params.description: The unique identifier of the transcript call

items.docs: Delete a specific call by its ID
